# 0. Data Prepration

```{python}
# packages
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis, QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, plot_tree
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, mean_squared_error, classification_report, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay, RocCurveDisplay, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_predict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

```

```{python}
# data
cah = pd.read_csv('classification_CAH_train.csv')

```

```{python}
X = cah.drop(['political_affiliation', 'id_num'], axis = 1)
y = cah['political_affiliation']
```

```{python}
# column transformer - dummies
ct_dummies = ColumnTransformer(
    [
    ("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False, handle_unknown="ignore", drop='first'), ["Q1", "Q4", "Q5", "Q6", "Q7", "Q8", "Q9", "Q10", "Q11", "Q12", "Q13", "Q14", "Q15", "Q16", "Q17", "Q18"])
    ],
    remainder = "passthrough"
)
```

```{python}
ct_interactions = ColumnTransformer(
    [
    ("interaction2", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q4_Moderate", "remainder__Q2"]), # ideology x age
    ("interaction2b", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q4_Liberal", "remainder__Q2"]), # ideology x age

    ("interaction3", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Latino", "dummify__Q10_Yes, very religious"]), # race x religion
    ("interaction3b", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Latino", "dummify__Q10_Yes, somewhat religious"]), # race x religion
    ("interaction3c", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Black", "dummify__Q10_Yes, very religious"]), # race x religion
    ("interaction3d", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Black", "dummify__Q10_Yes, somewhat religious"]), # race x religion
    ("interaction3e", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_White", "dummify__Q10_Yes, very religious"]), # race x religion
    ("interaction3f", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_White", "dummify__Q10_Yes, somewhat religious"]), # race x religion

    ("interaction4", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q10_Yes, very religious", "dummify__Q11_Pro-life"]), # religion x choice
    ("interaction4b", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q10_Yes, somewhat religious", "dummify__Q11_Pro-life"]), # religion x choice

    #("interaction5", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Latino", "dummify__Q5_High school or less"]), # race x education
    #("interaction5b", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Latino", "dummify__Q5_Some college"]), # race x education

    #("interaction5f", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["dummify__Q6_Black", "dummify__Q5_Graduate degree"]), # race x education

```

```{python}
# create empty list of accuracy score
accuracy_compare = []

cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=10, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
```

# LDA

```{python}
# make pipeline
lda_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [
    ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
    ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis())
  ]
)

# fit
lda_fitted = lda_pipeline.fit(X, y)

# cross-validation to estimate F1 score
scores = cross_val_score(lda_pipeline,
                         X=X,
                         y=y,
                         scoring="accuracy",
                         cv=cv)

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "lda", "accuracy": scores.mean()})

# report score here
scores.mean()
```

# QDA

```{python}
# make pipeline for tuning
qda_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [
    ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
    #("preprocessing2", ct_interactions),
    ("qda", QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis())]
)

tuning = {'qda__reg_param': np.arange(0, 1, 0.1)}

gscv = GridSearchCV(qda_pipeline, param_grid=tuning, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)

# feed in the data and fit
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the SVC inside it
qda_pipeline_best = gscv.best_estimator_
qda_model_best = qda_pipeline_best.named_steps["qda"]

# fit
qda_fitted = qda_pipeline_best.fit(X, y)

# cross-validation to estimate f1
scores = cross_val_score(qda_pipeline_best,
                         X=X,
                         y=y,
                         scoring="accuracy",
                         cv=5)

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "qda", "accuracy": scores.mean()})

# report score here
scores.mean()
```

# KNN

```{python}
# make pipeline for knn tuning
knn_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [
     ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
     ("standardize", StandardScaler()),
     ("knn", KNeighborsClassifier())
    ],
).set_output(transform="pandas")

neighbors = {'knn__n_neighbors': np.arange(1, 11, 1)}

gscv = GridSearchCV(knn_pipeline, param_grid=neighbors, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy')

# feed in data
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the SVC inside it
knn_pipeline_best = gscv.best_estimator_
knn_model_best = knn_pipeline_best.named_steps["knn"]

# fit
knn_fitted = knn_pipeline_best.fit(X, y)

# cross-validation to estimate f1
scores = cross_val_score(knn_pipeline_best,
                         X=X,
                         y=y,
                         scoring="accuracy",
                         cv=5)

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "knn", "accuracy": scores.mean()})

# report score here
scores.mean()
```

# Decision Tree

```{python}
# make pipeline for decision tree tuning
dt_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [
     ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
     ("dt", DecisionTreeClassifier())
    ],
).set_output(transform="pandas")

tuning = {
    'dt__ccp_alpha': np.arange(0, 1, 0.1),
    'dt__max_depth': np.arange(1,10, 1)
}

gscv = GridSearchCV(dt_pipeline, param_grid=tuning, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy')

# feed in data
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the SVC inside it
dt_pipeline_best = gscv.best_estimator_
dt_model_best = dt_pipeline_best.named_steps["dt"]

# fit
dt_fitted = dt_pipeline_best.fit(X, y)

# cross-validation to estimate f1
scores = cross_val_score(dt_pipeline_best,
                         X=X,
                         y=y,
                         scoring="accuracy",
                         cv=5)

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "dt", "accuracy": scores.mean()})

# report score here
scores.mean()
```

# Logistic OvR

```{python}
# make pipeline for logistic tuning
logistic_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [
   ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
   ("standardize", StandardScaler()),
   ("logistic", LogisticRegression(penalty = 'l1', max_iter=500)) #setting max iter reduces warnings
  ]
).set_output(transform="pandas")

# tune lasso penalty hyperparameter
# splitting up the L1 (lasso) penalty and the 'none' penalty like this reduce the warnings that occur because 'none' and 'C' do not match
param_grid = [
    # Case 1: L1 penalty (lasso)
    {
        'logistic__penalty': ['l1'],
        'logistic__C': [0.1, 1, 10],
        'logistic__solver': ['liblinear', 'saga']
    }
]

gscv = GridSearchCV(logistic_pipeline, param_grid=param_grid, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)

# feed in the data
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the logistic inside it
logistic_pipeline_best = gscv.best_estimator_
logistic_model_best = logistic_pipeline_best.named_steps["logistic"]

# make predictions
logit_acc = gscv.best_score_

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "logistic OvR", "accuracy": logit_acc})

# report score here
logit_acc 
```

**Adding Interactions**

```{python}
# make pipeline for logistic tuning
logistic_pipeline_ints = Pipeline(
  [
   ("preprocessing1", ct_dummies),
   ("preprocessing2", ct_interactions),
   ("standardize", StandardScaler()),
   ("logistic", LogisticRegression())
  ]
).set_output(transform="pandas")

# tune lasso penalty hyperparameter
# splitting up the L1 (lasso) penalty and the 'none' penalty like this reduce the warnings that occur because 'none' and 'C' do not match
param_grid = [
    # Case 1: L1 and L2 penalties
    {
        'logistic__penalty': ['l1', 'l2'],
        'logistic__C': [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100],
        'logistic__solver': ['liblinear', 'saga']
    },
    # Case 2: Elastic net (requires saga + l1_ratio)
    {
        'logistic__penalty': ['elasticnet'],
        'logistic__C': [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100],
        'logistic__solver': ['saga'],
        'logistic__l1_ratio': [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]   # try a few mixes
    },
    # Case 3: No penalty
    {
        'logistic__penalty': ['none'],
        'logistic__solver': ['lbfgs', 'saga']
    }
]

gscv = GridSearchCV(logistic_pipeline_ints, param_grid=param_grid, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)

# feed in the data
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the logistic inside it
logistic_pipeline_ints_best = gscv.best_estimator_
logistic_model_ints_best = logistic_pipeline_ints_best.named_steps["logistic"]

# make predictions
logit_acc = gscv.best_score_

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "logistic interactions OvR", "accuracy": logit_acc})

# report score here
logit_acc 
```

# SVM OvO
```{python}
# make pipeline for svc tuning
svm_pipeline = Pipeline(
  [
   ("preprocessing", ct_dummies),
   ("preprocessing2", ct_interactions),
   ("standardize", StandardScaler()),
   ("svm", SVC())
  ]
).set_output(transform="pandas")

param_grid = {
    'svm__C': [0.1, 1, 10],
    'svm__gamma': ['scale', 'auto', 0.1],
    'svm__kernel': ['rbf', 'poly']
    }
gscv = GridSearchCV(svm_pipeline, param_grid=param_grid, cv = cv, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)

# feed in the data
gscv_fitted = gscv.fit(X, y)

# Best fitted pipeline & the svc inside it
svm_pipeline_best = gscv.best_estimator_
svm_model_best = svm_pipeline_best.named_steps["svm"]

# make predictions
svm_acc = gscv.best_score_

# add to list
accuracy_compare.append({"model": "SVM OvO", "accuracy": svm_acc})

# report score here
svm_acc 
```

Save the best model - SVM OvO in this case
Refit with all the data
```{python}
best_model = gscv.best_estimator_
best_model.fit(X, y)   # Safe to do; grid search is already complete
```
